You can read more about our editorial guidelines and our products and services review methodology. 20 YearsHelping You Live Richer Reviewed by Experts Trusted by Millions of Readers Whether you’re planning ahead for a long weekend or rushing out for last-minute essentials, it helps to know if Dollar General is open on holidays. Most locations stay open year-round — with a few exceptions — making it a go-to spot for everyday needs and seasonal savings. Here’s what to expect from Dollar General during major U.S. holidays. Dollar General Regular Store Hours Most Dollar General stores are open daily from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. To check specific hours for your location, use the Dollar General Store Locator. Dollar General Major Holiday Schedule for 2026 Dollar General remains open for most federal and bank holidays, with the exception of Christmas Day, when all locations are closed. For other holidays, stores typically operate with normal or reduced hours. Here’s Dollar General’s expected store schedule for all major U.S. holidays in 2026: Holiday Date Hours New Year’s Day Thursday, Jan. 1 Open — 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. Martin Luther King, Jr. Day Monday, Jan. 19 Open regular hours Presidents Day Monday, Feb. 16 Open regular hours Easter Sunday Sunday, April 5 Open — hours may vary Memorial Day Monday, May 25 Open — 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. Juneteenth National Independence Day Friday, June 19 Open regular hours Independence Day Saturday, July 4 Open — 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. Labor Day Monday, Sept. 7 Open — 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. Columbus Day/Indigenous Peoples Day Monday, Oct. 12 Open regular hours Veterans Day Wednesday, Nov. 11 Open regular hours Thanksgiving Day Thursday, Nov. 26 Open — hours may vary Christmas Eve Thursday, Dec. 24 Open — hours may vary Christmas Day Friday, Dec. 25 Closed Keep In Mind Dollar General hours may vary slightly by location. Rural or smaller-format stores may close earlier or open later on holidays. Tips for Shopping at Dollar General During Holidays Shop early: Morning is the best time to avoid crowds and find fully stocked shelves. Grab holiday deals: Seasonal items, party supplies and decorations are often under $5. Use DG digital coupons: You can save on snacks, cleaning products and more through the app. Expect reduced staffing: Smaller stores may run lean crews on holidays. Call ahead: Confirm hours for your specific store to avoid last-minute surprises. More Holiday Hours Apple Costco CVS Kohl’s Lowe’s Macy’s Safeway Starbucks Target Trader Joe’s Walgreens Walmart Dollar General Holiday Hours FAQ Here are the answers to some of the most frequently asked questions about Dollar General's holiday hours. Is Dollar General open on Christmas Day? No. All Dollar General stores are closed on Christmas Day, the only holiday when every location shuts down nationwide. Is Dollar General open on Thanksgiving Day? Yes, most locations are open with reduced hours on Thanksgiving. Hours may vary by location, so check ahead. Can I shop at Dollar General on New Year’s Day or July 4th? Yes. Dollar General is open on both New Year’s Day and Independence Day, typically operating under regular hours — 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. Do all Dollar General stores open at the same time on holidays? Not always. While most locations follow the standard schedule, some rural or mall-based stores may open later or close earlier depending on staffing and local guidelines. Does Dollar General offer holiday deals or seasonal discounts? Yes. Look for deep discounts on seasonal items, including home décor, snacks and party supplies — especially around major holidays. Schedules are subject to change and may vary by location. Information is accurate as of Dec. 10, 2025. Editorial Note: This content is not provided by any entity covered in this article.
